turns.text: Um, this is a big question, do you want a deep question?
turns.zh: 嗯，这个问题有点大，你想来个深刻点的问题吗？

turns.text: I don't, I feel like crying reading this question.
turns.zh: 我不行，我读这个问题就想哭。

turns.text: What are you currently doubting in your life?
turns.zh: 你现在生活中在怀疑什么？
